name: Wyrmstooth

startedBy.speaker: Athir
startedBy.prompt: Is there anything I can do to help?
reply: I suppose there is something you could do for me.
You see, I've been searching for a certain blade. An heirloom of sorts, that I'd like to get my hands on.
The last anyone knows, it had fallen into the hands of the Forsworn of the Reach. I was hoping I'd stumble across it eventually.
If you find it, I'd much appreciate it if you would bring it back to me. The blade's name is Embersunder.
The one place I haven't yet been to is Hag's End, south-west of Solitude. The Forsworn there may have their hands on it.
startedBy.conditions: fn310 == 1; Retrieving Embersunder hasn't started; Barrow of the Wyrm stage >= 270; the speaker is Athir

firstObjective.text: Speak to Lurius Liore at the docks in Solitude.

movedBy.speaker: Lurius Liore
reply: Great. I'll let everyone know we're ready to set sail.
Head below deck and get some shut eye. It'll take a few hours for us to get there and we'll need to be fully rested to face whatever is in store.

startedBy.speaker: Daenlit
startedBy.prompt: Is there anything I can do to help?
reply: There is, if you have the time.
There's a certain necklace I would like to get my hands on. It's valuable, yes, but there's more to it than that.
It's enchantment... well, I'll let you figure that one out. It's currently in the possession of Erikur, a fool of a merchant living in Solitude.
Bring it to me and I'll see to it that you're properly... rewarded.

startedBy.speaker: Theodyn Bienne
startedBy.prompt: Who are you and what do you want?
reply: I was asked to find you as soon as possible. If you ask me, this problem sounds urgent.
You'd best head on over to The Bannered Mare in Whiterun. Speak to Lurius Liore. He mentioned something about trouble with a dragon.
And the promise of a generous reward. Sounds tempting, if I were you I'd best not keep him waiting.

firstObjective.text: Speak to Lurius Liore at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun

objective.text: Meet up with the mercenaries on the road to Falkreath

movedBy.speaker: Lurius Liore
reply: I'll mark the rendezvous point on your map.
When you get there, speak to Athir. If he's done his job then he should know by now where that dragon has been roosting.
If we're lucky we might be able to catch that dragon by surprise and put an end to the trouble its been causing.
I wish you the best of luck, Dragonborn. I'll be waiting here for your return.
movedBy.conditions: Wyrmstooth stage == 10; the speaker is Lurius Liore

startedBy.speaker: Elmera
reply: In Oblivion. More specifically, Mehrunes Dagon's realm of Oblivion.
I suppose ever since that whole fiasco with Martin and the Dragonfires, travel to the Deadlands and back has been made somewhat more difficult.
But let it be said that nothing is impossible!

startedBy.speaker: Shargam
startedBy.prompt: Is there anything I can do to help?
reply: There is.
I'm working the mines here, so I haven't had time to take care of personal problems.
Go to Skyrim, to Markarth, and find Ulfgar. He'll be staying at the Silver-Blood Inn. Once you find him, kill him.
He owes me gold and I've lost my patience. Give him a good swift death.
If anyone catches you, kill them too. Kill everyone if you have to.

speakerPlaced: Hulgard And Svenja's House, Hulgard and Svenja's House
startedBy.prompt: Maybe I could steal that ledger?

But you've been to Solitude, right? Maybe you know where he lives?
Just don't tell mama and papa I told you to do this, or I'll get into trouble again!

movedBy.speaker: Dunyick
movedBy.prompt: Which direction did your wolf go?
reply: She headed down the hill, past the town and off towards the mountains. I've tried calling for her, but maybe she's too scared to return.
With these injuries I can't track her myself but she'll follow you now that you have my scent.
Just keep an eye out for a wolf with a rust colored pelt. She shouldn't be too hard to spot against the white snow. Hurry, before hunters catch her!

startedBy.prompt: Is there anything I can help you with?
reply: I suppose there is something you could do for me, if you're up for it.
I'm running low on wisp wrappings. I only have a couple left and they're absolutely critical to my ... err ... experiments.
Bring me five and I'll give you some sort of enchanted weapon. It'll be useful for hitting things. That is what you adventurers do, right?
Wait! Five might be too few, I might run out too quickly. Better make it eight ... or fifteen? Scratch that, eight should be enough. Hmph. Or is it?

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
